title: The Bullet Cluster Under EFC: Confronting Entropy-Gradient Gravity with JWST-Era Mass Reconstructions
author: Morten Magnusson
type: consistency check, analytical confrontation, pre-registered test pending

external_studies_confronted.citation: Cha, S., Jee, M. J., Finner, K., et al. 2025, ApJ, 987, L15
external_studies_confronted.contribution: Highest-resolution JWST mass reconstruction (146 SL + 398 arcmin^-2 WL); SIDM bound sigma/m < 0.5 cm^2 g^-1; ICL-mass Hausdorff 19.80 +/- 12.46 kpc

external_studies_confronted.citation: Rihtarsic, G., Bradac, M., Desprez, G., et al. 2026, submitted
external_studies_confronted.contribution: First spectroscopically anchored parametric lens model (135 secure multiple images, 27 systems, z_spec 0.9-6.7)

external_studies_confronted.citation: Cho, H., Jee, M. J., Cha, S., et al. 2025, submitted
external_studies_confronted.contribution: JWST/NIRCam + DECam virial masses M_200c^main = 15.1x10^14 M_sun, M_200c^sub = 1.5x10^14 M_sun; establishes ~10:1 minor merger

four_axes.axis: Cluster merger geometry (structural exclusion under revised 10:1 mass ratio)
four_axes.note: Minor merger amplifies isotropic/anisotropic lensing distinction; 1.5e14 M_sun subcluster sits in partial-screening regime; three-subclump main cluster adds geometric constraints

SIDM cross-section bound sigma/m < 0.5 cm^2 g^-1 (Cha 2025)

mu~1.1 baryonic rescaling (13.7e14 M_sun) remains insufficient for full mass discrepancy; Relativistic Action solution on Cho profile is a planned pipeline item

frozen_parameters.source: EFC Validation Ledger v3.11; no new parameters introduced

main_result.verdict: null hypothesis validated — PIEMD parametric halos produce no directional asymmetry at shock front
main_result.discriminating_test: A_sig on delta_kappa = kappa_obs - kappa_PIEMD (requires Cha et al. free-form kappa-map; pending)
main_result.efc_prediction_full_residual: A_sig != 0 aligned with Chandra shock front

key_findings: Three JWST-era studies (Cha 2025, Rihtarsic 2026, Cho 2025) do not falsify EFC and do not positively support it over LCDM
10:1 mass ratio strengthens the structural exclusion test (DOI 31173850), not weakens it
SIDM tightening to sigma/m < 0.5 cm^2 g^-1 is consistent with EFC's no-particle ontology
PIEMD A_sig baseline is a null (p=0.98), validating the test operator but not EFC itself
Pre-registered A_sig test on free-form delta_kappa residual remains the only decisive discriminator at cluster scale
Given v3.11 growth-sector null (B=0 within 1sigma), the lensing-sector Sigma must carry the L2 signal if EFC is correct
limitations: A_sig baseline uses PIEMD with placeholder parameters (not Rihtarsic et al. Table 4 best-fit values)
Baseline null validates the test operator, not the physical hypothesis — needs free-form kappa-map residual
Regime-transition P1 confronted qualitatively only; EFC field equations not solved on Cho et al. mass profile
ICL directionality discriminator is speculative (sub-10 kpc Hausdorff precision not yet achieved)
Non-perturbative effects in the shock-front region are not yet computed
next_steps: Obtain Cha et al. (2025) free-form kappa-map FITS and compute delta_kappa = kappa_obs - kappa_PIEMD
Apply A_sig pipeline (src/asig_2d_piemd.py) to the residual — the decisive test
Replace placeholder PIEMD parameters with Rihtarsic et al. (2026) Table 4 best-fit values
Cross-check with Abell 2146 (second pre-registered A_sig target)
Solve EFC Relativistic Action field equations on Cho et al. virial mass profile to obtain quantitative mu(r), Sigma(r)
